clips.title: The story
paras: Across Darkshore and the Barrens, druids use Curative Animal Salve to treat sick wildlife. Herbalists prepare it in both lands, while the Cenarion Circle sees the animals’ afflictions as signs of a wider blight.

Druids use Curative Animal Salve to ease sick wildlife in Darkshore and the Barrens. Alanndarian Nightsong directs young druids to treat sick deer between the Cliffspring River and the borders of Ashenvale. In the Barrens, Tonga Runetotem brews the same remedy for sick gazelles grazing north of the Crossroads. Each herbalist prepares the salve from locally gathered herbs in batches of ten doses. Field practitioners apply it directly to the animals, while both herbalists work with local authorities to produce larger supplies.

The salve eases an animal’s suffering, but the Cenarion Circle sees the afflictions as signs of a wider disturbance. In Moonglade, Dendrite Starblaze observes that the afflicted deer on the coast and the suffering gazelles on the savannah are no random casualties. They are unwitting victims of a blight spreading across Kalimdor from multiple directions. For initiates, treating the animals tests their dedication to protecting nature and their skill in cleansing poison.
